findings.title: test_no_reader_facing_surface_publishes_a_superseded_deity_population is non-falsifiable on the artifacts it names

findings.title: The ABOUT_CONCEPT reconciliation is arithmetically right and substantively mislabeled, and hides 91 unexplained retirements
anchors: src/vedagraph/domain/layer_figures.py :: 'Reconciles exactly against it: 46,439 rows, MINUS the 21,603 whose evidence is English-only and which V3 retired, PLUS 25 Sanskrit-evidenced pairs landed outside this artifact (16 of them hotr-) = 24,861.'
findings.measured: concept_assertions.jsonl holds 46,439 rows and 46,439 distinct (concept, passage) pairs. English-only rows = 21,526 under every definition I could construct (surfaces=={translation_en}: 21,526; method 'concept-alias-v1:english': 21,526; no script_folded and no sandhi: 21,526; no script_folded at all: 22,002). 21,603 matches nothing about evidence - it is 46,439 minus the 24,836 artifact pairs that landed. Applying the STATED rule gives 46,439 - 21,526 + 25 = 24,938, not 24,861. The true reconciliation is 24,913 Sanskrit-evidenced pairs, MINUS 91 of them not landed (SOMA-DRINK 15, YAJNA-SACRIFICE 12, VASU-WEALTH 7, SOMA-PRESSING 6, RAKSAS-DEMON 5, AGNI-FIRE 5, VAJA-PRIZE 4, BHESAJA-HEALING 4, and 19 further concepts), PLUS 39 landed outside that set - 25 absent from the artifact entirely, of which exactly 16 are HOTR-PRIEST (that half of the claim is exactly right), and 14 English-only pairs that landed contrary to the stated rule.
findings.defect: The declared constant 24,861 is correct and matches the live graph. The warrant beside it does not reproduce, and in not reproducing it conceals 91 Sanskrit-evidenced retirements with no recorded reason and 14 English-only retentions that contradict the rule the comment states. This is the corrections_applied-drifts-from-rows shape: read the row, not the audit block.
findings.must_change: Restate the comment as the measured decomposition (24,913 - 91 + 39) and record why the 91 were withheld; or name 21,603 as 'artifact pairs that did not land' rather than as the English-only population.
